Verified sample B(a,b) families directly against the five four-car orbit polynomial differences; the falling factorial orbit construction uses at most four distinct outer leaves and proves all positive integer a,b, not an interpolation. For m=4 n=10 direct counts are N_c=9290,N_diameter=9263. The proof sharply separates exhaustive n<=10 census from its all-(a,b) exact identity.
